title: जब ऋषि की बहन नदी बन गईं | रामायण भाग 9
topic: Vishvamitra's sister Satyavati, who became the Kaushiki river, the hushed midnight on the Shona, and the dawn march to the Ganga (Valmiki Ramayana 1.34.7–1.35.12; teaser 1.35.12)

sources.note: the sage: that Gadhi is my father; I am Kaushika of Kusha's line (Ep08 reveal, context for the hook)
my elder sister (पूर्वजा भगिनी) of good vows, Satyavati by name, was given in marriage to Richika
following her husband, she went to heaven in her own body (सशरीरा); that noble Kaushiki flowed forth as a great river (Ep08 teaser)
divine, holy-watered, lovely, resting on Himavat, my sister flowed forth for the good of the world
so I dwell content on the flank of Himavat, bound by love for my sister Kaushiki (verse card)
Satyavati, holy, steadfast in truth and dharma, devoted to her husband, Kaushiki best of rivers
for my vow (नियमात्) I left her and came to Siddhashrama; by your splendour (तव तेजसा) I have succeeded
half the night has passed while I told these tales; sleep, bless you; let there be no hindrance on our road
the trees are motionless, beasts and birds have hidden, darkness fills the quarters; twilight fades, the sky is thick with stars; the cool moon rises, gladdening all hearts
Rama too, with Saumitri, a little wonderstruck (किञ्चिदागतविस्मयः), praised the sage and slept
after the rest of the night on the Shona bank, at dawn the sage wakes Rama: arise, make ready to go
they travel on past many forests; when half the day has gone they see the Jahnavi (Ganga), best of rivers, thronged with swans and cranes; all rejoice
Rama: I wish to hear of the Ganga, the river of three paths; how did she pervade the three worlds and reach the lord of rivers (the ocean)? (teaser verse)
urged by Rama, the sage begins the Ganga's birth and growth: Himavan, lord of mountains, had two daughters (next episode)

learnings.how: Applied in part. The stakes and the wonder are in the first line (the sage's own sister became a river, paying off the Ep08 teaser), and the means (heaven in her own body) lands by about 8–12 s. The 35 s anecdote shape is not used: the beat needs the sister, the sage's love and vow, the night and the dawn arrival, so the 45 s shape is stretched toward 53 s for flow, as the owner asked.

Applied. The hook is 2.45 s, under the 3.0 s limit, with the stake in the first sentence. The gu hook is written natively short (ઋષિની સગી બહેન નદી બની ગયાં), not translated. The en hook is 2.74 s, inside the 2.5–2.8 s Kokoro-safe band. Frame 0 is the river landscape, which the engine draws at least 70% by frame 0 (O5).

Applied within the owner's flow rule. The estimates sit at 52.6–52.9 s: the upper end of the 45–53 s band the owner set for flow, inside 35–55 s, with te and mr at or under 53 s. Flow beats shortness this time, by the owner's instruction.
